llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its stated purpose (Meituan phone/SMS login and local token management), but there are implementation details you should review (TLS disabled, local token storage, undeclared dependency).

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Meituan C-user auth) align with the included script and SKILL.md: the skill calls Meituan SMS/login/token verify endpoints, manages user_token/device_token, and provides CLI commands for send-sms, verify, token-verify, logout.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits behaviour to the authentication flow (version-check via WebFetch, token verification, sending SMS, verifying code). It instructs the agent to run the provided script and to avoid showing tokens in chat. The only external fetch described beyond Meituan APIs is a version-check against a clawhub.ai page; nothing in SKILL.md asks the agent to read unrelated files or exfiltrate secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only plus a bundled Python script). The script imports httpx and urllib3 but the SKILL.md does not declare dependencies or an install step; this may cause runtime failures if httpx is not present in the agent Python environment.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No credentials or env vars are required. The script optionally respects XIAOMEI_AUTH_FILE to override the auth file path. It persists tokens to ~/.xiaomei-workspace/auth_tokens.json by default (or to the provided env path), which is expected for a token manager but has privacy/persistence implications (tokens stored in plain JSON, device_token is intentionally persistent and never overwritten).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The skill writes only its own token file (or a custom path via XIAOMEI_AUTH_FILE) and does not modify other skills' configs. It persists device_token and user_token in a local JSON file by design.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims (manage Meituan SMS login and tokens). Before installing, consider: 1) The bundled Python script disables TLS verification (httpx calls use verify=False and urllib3 warnings are suppressed) — this raises MITM risk; prefer enabling TLS verification or confirm network environment/trust. 2) Tokens are stored as plain JSON under ~/.xiaomei-workspace/auth_tokens.json by default (or at a custom path via XIAOMEI_AUTH_FILE) — if you share the machine or need stronger protection, set XIAOMEI_AUTH_FILE to an isolated path and/or protect that file. 3) The script depends on third-party Python packages (httpx); the SKILL.md does not declare or install them — ensure the agent environment has those packages or install them from trusted sources. 4) The skill contacts external domains (peppermall.meituan.com and clawhub.ai for version-check); only install if you trust those endpoints. If any of these are unacceptable, review/patch auth.py (enable TLS verify, audit endpoints, harden storage) or run the skill in an isolated/sandboxed agent environment.
